messages.author: fe10506dfe348dfc
messages.subject: install rhdfs 1.0.3
parts:
Hi,

I don't know what happend but my previous post is lost I think.
But right now I'm installing rhdfs on my Mac OS X 10.7.4 machine.

I all ready installed rmr, rhbase and hadoop successfully but when I try to install rhdfs with the following command:
sudo -E R CMD INSTALL /Users/marcelboersma/Downloads/rhdfs_1.0.3.tar.gz

Then I get the following error message:
* installing to library ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.15/Resources/library’
* installing *source* package ‘rhdfs’ ...
** R
** inst
** preparing package for lazy loading
** help
*** installing help indices
** building package indices
** testing if installed package can be loaded
*** arch - i386
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'rhdfs', details:
  call: fun(libname, pkgname)
  error: Environment variable HADOOP_HOME must be set before loading package rhdfs
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
*** arch - x86_64
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'rhdfs', details:
  call: fun(libname, pkgname)
  error: Environment variable HADOOP_HOME must be set before loading package rhdfs
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
ERROR: loading failed for ‘i386’, ‘x86_64’
* removing ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.15/Resources/library/rhdfs’

Here are my path settings:
declare -x HADOOP_CONF="/usr/local/Cellar/hadoop/1.0.1/libexec/conf"
declare -x HADOOP_HOME="/usr/local/Cellar/hadoop/1.0.1"

Does anybody now how to fix this?

Thx

Marcel Boersma

messages.author: 1eafd5d24fb29c12
messages.subject: Re: install rhdfs 1.0.3
parts: If you are installing as sudo your HADOOP_HOME and HADOOP_CONF settings won't necessarily be carried forward.

messages.subject: Re: install rhdfs 1.0.3
parts:
sudo -E should preserve exported variables but I am not familiar with this declare command, we do exports around here. Not saying it is wrong, just 
unfamiliar. The other thing I can think of is that with the latest hadoop HADOOP_HOME may not be sufficient as the layout has changed. At least that happened to rmr

Antonio
